text: The guard pockets it and steps aside.
I am Kael-7. Seventh iteration. Purified Paladin.
The Signal signature... Walker frequency. Impossible.
I am Mara of the Verdant Choir.
The Signal... it sings in you.
Kael. I need technology to survive.
Mara. I need to understand what I've become.
Both of you. We're going the same direction.
Why should I trust either of you?
You have fallen. The Signal fades...
